richiami.difetto: The affected tyre is more susceptible to cuts and partial penetrations than anticipated when used in rugged and wet environments. These cuts can lead to moisture intrusion and subsequent oxidation of the tyre belt. resulting in tyre deformation and if use continues without detection may result in tread delamination. (The number of vehicles affected to which these tyres are fitted is 62216 vehicles)
